captions.instagram:
Moved from F-1 (OPT) to H-1B this year? A few tax rules change on the switch date.

✔️ Social Security and Medicare withholding starts on the day your H-1B status begins (often Oct. 1).
✔️ Your days as an F-1 student still don't count toward the 183-day test.
✔️ Switched Oct. 1? That's 92 days in 2026, so 2026 may still be a Form 1040-NR year. A first-year choice to be treated as a resident may apply, depending on your days.
✔️ Next year, as an H-1B who meets the test, it's usually Form 1040.

We prepare both: student package (1040-NR + 8843 + tax-treaty check) $99 federal, $129 with one state return; H-1B Form 1040 at our standard 1040 pricing. Federal plus NJ and NY returns. Book a call to start. Not available for CA, CT, MD or OR state returns.

Tax information only, not immigration advice.

sources.fact: Employer must start withholding FICA on the effective date of the H-1B status change, typically Oct. 1 (read 2026-10-24)
Substantial presence test: 31 days this year and 183 days over 3 years (1, 1/3, 1/6); days as an exempt individual (F/J/M/Q students) don't count (read 2026-10-24)
Exempt individuals' residency starting date may be later than arrival; first-year choice exists (read 2026-10-25)
First-Year Choice: someone who didn't meet the test in the current or prior year but meets it the following year can choose resident treatment for part of the current year (read 2026-10-24)
